So fed up with sitting in the drive thru for my morning coffee and having the car in front order 3 kids meals and 2 adult meals
I don't mind it when people get a lot of food at a drive-thru. It's the ones who don't know what they want to order that drive me insane.

This happened to me at In and Out one time. I thought they were ordering a bunch of stuff, because they took maybe 5 straight minutes of looking at the board, which is a long time for fast food drive through. They were only given one freaking bag...In and Out probably has the smallest menu there is.
This is especially dangerous as most times I haven't had my coffee yet as it is waiting at the drive-thru window behind all their crap.

Here's the thing, though--usually the orders are getting filled in the order they are placed, regardless of whether they're placed inside or outside. Unless you were literally the only car in the drive though with your coffee order, if the big family went inside and ordered all that food, they would still be in line in front of, say, the person in front of you who was ordering a full one-person breakfast in the drive through. Most of the "order prep" for drive through orders is done by someone other than the person who hands you your food. They usually only prepare your beverages.

Understood. I worked in a drive thru right when I graduated high school and yes, the orders are all place chronologically to the kitchen. But when I order my coffee it is different cause the drive thru worker gets it themselves so there is minimal wait time.

The up side to this is that when I finally do get to the window my coffee is usually waiting for me and I'm done my transaction in less than a minute.
The only way to make it faster would be if you had a beverages only lane. We have a drive-through Starbucks near us so that's an option...
Honestly, most times I can park, walk in, pick up my cup of coffee, hop back in the car, and take off before the last car that was in the drive thru line has even paid yet.

Just walk in if you're in a rush.

A) The line typically moves quicker.

B) If you're only getting a coffee, you'll order, get your coffee, and then leave. As opposed to ordering, waiting in line to get to the window, and then waiting for your coffee there.
